messages:
ops-bot: Automated alert: spike in LB client retries for cross-region flows (detected by retry-sentinel). Severity flagged as potential Sev2.
noah-park: Noticed spike ~14:10 UTC, primarily when requests route through cross-region path via us-central. Error: TLS alert(40) during resume/reneg.
sara-ng: Can someone check recent LB config pushes? We had a small rollout window earlier today.
jen-p: Rolling back recent edge policy didn't fully restore baseline. Logs show duplicate SNI header injection for some flows. sample snippet: 
```
[2026-04-01T14:09:52Z] ingress: sni=api.redwood.example, sni=api.redwood.example; applied=2
```
rashid: That double apply smells like zone-sync overlap. We've seen similar when config propagation races with partial reconcilers.
noah-park: Repro steps: from ap-southeast probe -> eu-west lb -> backend. Result: connection closed during TLS handshake. curl: 
```
$ curl -I https://api.redwood.example/health --resolve api.redwood.example:443:18.205.33.4
HTTP/2 502
```
sara-ng: Ok action list, keep items minimal and owners assigned here:
- Action 1: Audit rollout history & identify if rollout-1968 included duplicate-sni patch. Owner: @noah-park. ETA: 12h. Ticket NET-4201.
- Action 2: Deploy short-lived probe (tls-renego-canary) that exercises resume/reneg across regions. Owner: @jen-p. ETA: 36h. Alert if retry rate > 2x baseline.
- Action 3: Add a rate-limiter on LB control-plane apply to prevent duplicate SNI application during zone sync. Owner: @rashid. ETA: 5 days. RFC NET-4202.
- Action 4: Hotfix: apply client-side backoff multiplier and reduce immediate retry attempts for cross-region routes. Owner: @sara-ng. ETA: 2h.
noah-park: Filed NET-4201 with applied-config diffs and timestamps. linking to rollout-1968 artifacts.
jen-p: Canary scheduled and running in canary pool. Initial results show 1.8x baseline, will escalate if >2.
rashid: Starting RFC draft, will include a guard mechanic and observability knobs.
sara-ng: Ops note: Hotfix will increase latency slightly for some requests but prevents backend saturation. Proceeding to push.
ops-bot: Hotfix deployed to 30% traffic. Monitoring for 15 minutes.
noah-park: Observability: Adding a dashboard panel for "tls_resume_retry_rate" and tagging by rollout-id + region. Also adding log parser to extract duplicate-sni events. ETA: 48h.
jen-p: Recurring incident observation: matches pattern from Jan and Feb where config churn + TLS session resumption caused retry storms. Recommend a recurring postmortem monthly check for rollout propagation metrics. Owner: @sara-ng. ETA: 2 weeks.
sara-ng: Scheduling 20-min follow-up tomorrow 09:30 UTC to review NET-4201/4202 and decide postmortem authors. I'll update this thread after the meeting. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied, currently monitoring. Severity: Sev2. Further updates will be appended to this thread.
